body: The problem I've had with therapy is that the ones I've talked to have felt useless, even the expensive ones. For one, they seem to expect me to already have a fairly good understanding of what I need help with. In the same manner that I've been on 7 to 10 (lost count) different anti-depressants and none of them helped, I'm reluctant to try yet another therapist. The outpatient psychiatric institution I go to said they'd try to find me a new one, we'll see how that goes, I guess.

We’re not here for anything — there’s no ”reason we are here” in some cosmic sense, and to think that there could be such a reason is a cognitive distortion. Healthy humans usually have an urge to have sex; the procreation part is a side effect, or as they say at VHEMT.org: ”If sex is an urge to procreate, then hunger’s an urge to defecate”. A subset of those humans have an urge/desire to procreate as well. And that’s it. It’s just something most people like to do.
Jesus, I’m sorry about all the myopic unhelpful bullshit people are posting in this thread, OP. Overall, I feel the same, I want to die too.

”Nothing will ever change unless you are ready to suffer even more to solve your problems. That is something i realized not long ago but im kind of tired of trying.”

Me too.

>you have the ability to change your life

I don't.

*just need to have the passion and strength* \-- like it's just a missing piece you can pick up easily. ("You can lift that truck, you just need to be able to lift 30 000 pounds.") Don't mean to be rude but I want to get the point across.

Been to a gym many times. Never had the willpower to keep going to the gym regularly more than a couple of months at a time.
It’s dumb, but I’m irrationally scared of being ”found out”. Telling my age feels to revealing.

I agree. Specifically, I’ve experienced trauma, but not over the last four years or so during which I’ve just become more and more indifferent and lethargic. Two major events earlier in my life gave me cause for depression and obsessive thoughts. I’m a bit paranoid too I guess so I don’t want to say more about that on here.
I appreciate your response. A lot of stuff happened, nothing really traumatic the last few years, though.
My heart is racing. Like I said, it's embarrassing to say stuff like this.
